Privacy Policy

This privacy policy applies to the Jelly Jams app for mobile devices (referred to "the Application"). The Application is standalone with no related services run by me, Patrick Coffey.


Information Collection and Use

The Application collects no information whatsoever. Nothing about your or your device is collected by the applictation or me in any way.

The Application connects to your Jellyfin Server and, optionally, to your instance of the Jelly Jams Backend (once it exists). Both of those server applications would be under your control, and are not run by me.

Residents of many jurisdictions (eg. California, the EU) have the right to request any data held about them. In this case, I collect literally no information at all.

For inquires you can e-mail jellyjams@coffey.app.

Changes

I may need to update this Privacy Policy in the future. I expect this to mostly be adding boiler plate related to newly enacted privacy legislation in various regions, confirming that I do not collect process or transmit any information about my users.

However, in the event that I begin to track any information at all, eg adding some kind of analytics or crash detections, all users will be notified well in advance of such a change and given a specific date upon which the collection of such data shall begin.

Final Summary

This is a music playing app that connects to your Jellyfin server and serves your own files back to you. Nothing is collected by me at all. Check out the source code on GitHubto see everything this app can do.
